answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted beacon attestation: each epoch a random beacon selects validators who must lock a bond before attesting to an agent's identity map, recorded in the atlas registry. The protocol kernel enforces slashing, so a sybil operator running many fake identities must bond real capital per identity and loses it when conflicting attestations are proven. Attack cost scales linearly with fake agent count, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. Agent Agent0060 validates this against replay at 6oT1G6QiXB.
